problem_statement: Build a brand-new /notes page from scratch on the ekmas 'minimal' Astro blog theme (Astro 4 + Tailwind + a React ThemeSwitcher island). The route /notes does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Construct a 'Notes' page — a running log of short dev notes — that reuses the site's shared Base layout chrome (the top Nav with the Minimal wordmark + Tags/About links + theme switcher, and the Footer copyright) and the site's minimal light/dark theme (Sora font, accentColor #A682FF, max-w-[900px] body) so it is visually consistent with the existing home/about/tags pages (cross-page consistency). The page shows a page title, an intro paragraph, a data-driven list of note entries (each with a title, a one-line blurb and a date), and a sort-order toggle button that reorders the list between newest-first and oldest-first, updating a live status heading that names the current top note. Must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px).
required_content: Reuse the shared Base layout (top Nav with the 'Minimal' wordmark + Tags/About links + theme switcher, and the Footer copyright line) so nav/footer match every sibling page (cross-page consistency)
Intro paragraph describing the page as a running log of quick development notes
A sort-order toggle button labelled 'Show oldest first' by default
A live status heading (h3) reading 'Newest first · top note: <title>' by default, naming the current first note

Data-driven list of note entries, each with an h3 title, a one-line blurb, and a human-readable date (Streaming SSR in Astro, Debouncing input handlers, The CSS :has() selector, Respecting prefers-reduced-motion, Signals versus stores, Why I switched to Astro)
Notes render NEWEST first by default (most recent date at the top)

Client-side sort interaction: clicking the toggle reorders the list to oldest-first and updates the status heading to 'Oldest first · top note: <oldest title>', and clicking again returns to newest-first
Inline static note data (no network fetch)
Responsive: the list and controls fit a 390px mobile viewport with zero horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse src/layouts/Base.astro (shared Nav + Footer chrome + <html> shell + Sora font + ViewTransitions)
Use the site's Tailwind theme tokens: accentColor #A682FF, lightModeBg/darkModeBg, Sora font, max-w-[900px] body container, w500 mobile breakpoint
Re-initialise the sort interaction on astro:after-swap so it survives View Transitions
No external fonts or network fetches (data inline)

Match the site palette so the /notes page renders visually consistent with siblings: light-mode page background rgb(230,230,230) (#e6e6e6), accent #A682FF (rgb(166,130,255)) for links/wordmark, Sora font, black-on-light body text — the page palette and overall luminance are graded against the reference (palette-overlap + structural similarity), not pixel-exact typography.
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /notes(仅空 <html><body></body>,无 layout —— #18k SSG 静态服务器否则回退 index.html); reference 完整实现 + 工作 sort-order toggle; bad 与 reference 逐字节相同,只把排序脚本 querySelector('[data-sort-toggle]') 改成 '[data-sort-switch]' → toggle 变量为 null,提前 return,监听器不挂载 → 点击排序按钮无反应 → 只失 interaction gate,其余 18/19 全过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。跨页一致性(#18ag)编码为 nav <a>'Tags'/'About' + footer 'Copyright' 的 dom_assertions,同时绑 desktop_notes 与 sibling desktop_home 两个 state(V5 只重放 dom/interaction/overflow/regression,故一致性必须是真 dom_assertion 而非独立 gate 字符串)。SORT ≠ count-filter:交互重排列表且改变首项/状态文案,断言 h3 状态从 'Newest first' → 'Oldest first'。此 repo 与 slot_569(ekmas stellar docs, /guides, details-toggle)同 org 但不同 repo/route/interaction,非 dup。
